recipes.name: Chocolate & Hazelnut Milkshake Smoothie
instructions: To a blender, add the bananas, milk, hazelnut butter, cocoa powder, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Then add the dates and blend briefly so that some small chunks remain to add some texture*.
Serve in a glass or a bowl with desired toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * This step is optional. If you prefer, you can also blend the dates until smooth.
Storage Best to enjoy this smoothie immediately.
